fields.name: Title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Retained display title (maximum 255 characters). New rows use a bounded canonical-source title; existing populated text is protected. A source difference alone does not prove an approved correction.

fields.name: SourceFullTitle
fields.title: SourceFullTitle
fields.description: Full canonical-source title in plain text, filled only when empty; existing text is protected. Optional blank alone does not prove a missing or truncated title. Raw source payload remains in the archive.

fields.name: field_1
fields.title: SourceKey
fields.description: Source-level lookup key, including retained aliases; not a canonical-publication or person ID. Legacy blank-key placeholders remain stored and are counted separately from keyed publication records.

fields.name: field_2
fields.title: CanonicalKey
fields.description: Canonical publication identity for joins/deduplication. Publication totals count distinct accepted canonical keys, not registry rows, source aliases, author mentions or researcher-label groups.

fields.name: field_3
fields.title: Authors
fields.description: Retained semicolon-separated author labels. Source-list positions generate mentions; labels and repeated/case-variant names are not resolved people, employment evidence or contribution measures.

fields.name: field_5
fields.title: PublicationYear
fields.description: Retained publication year; interpret with PublicationDateRaw and PublicationDatePrecision. Not a harvest/processing year. Do not infer a missing publication month or day.

fields.name: field_6
fields.title: PublicationMonth
fields.description: Publication period YYYY-MM when supported; blank means the month is unknown/unverified. Year/range/feed-only evidence must not be assigned an invented month. Reporting-period bounds are distinct from an exact publication date.

fields.name: field_7
fields.title: PublicationDateRaw
fields.description: Retained date text from the source projection, not necessarily a parseable date or the original API payload. Read with date precision; original source evidence remains in the retained archive.

fields.name: field_8
fields.title: PublicationDatePrecision
fields.description: day/month/year describe available publication-date precision; range is not an exact date. unknown/rss_unverified do not establish a publication month. Never invent missing day/month values.

fields.name: field_15
fields.title: CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors
fields.description: Retained names from publication-level affiliation evidence. Not resolved person identities, current employment or a staff census. Preserve labels and prior edits; blank is unknown, not proof of no affiliated authors.

fields.name: field_17
fields.title: ReviewStatus
fields.description: Included/Needs Review/Excluded are retained status labels. Explicit Excluded records remain stored but are omitted from publication readers. Needs Review is informational, not a routine per-publication approval prerequisite.

fields.name: field_18
fields.title: ReviewNotes
fields.description: Retained notes; presence alone is not approval or a structured correction ledger. A corrected-value claim needs explicit old/new values, evidence, rule/version and decision provenance; unresolved source differences stay pending.

fields.name: field_19
fields.title: FirstObservedUTC
fields.description: Registry first-seen processing timestamp: current writer uses utcNow() on create and preserves it on replay. Not the publication date or proof of source harvest/retrieval time; source observation evidence is retained separately.

fields.name: field_20
fields.title: LastObservedUTC
fields.description: Registry latest-upsert processing timestamp: current writer uses utcNow(), including replay. Not proof of changed content or a new external-source observation. Text storage; do not treat it as publication date.
